items.text: Race mode got a full overhaul. There are ready-made races with bronze, silver and gold medals. You can race alone or with the whole lobby. Every race has a leaderboard. There is one just for your friends too.

You can also build your own route in the route creator and share it on mod.io. Shared routes work on PC, PlayStation and Xbox. When the host picks a route, the whole lobby gets it automatically. Race replays record the whole lobby now.
Arctic Cat is in the garage! You get the M 858 with a 146, 154 or 165 inch track, and the HCR 858. More Arctic Cats come in December.
The Lynx, Ski-Doo and Polaris sleds are now **2027 models**.
The update also has five new achievements, a helmet to unlock, and new translations.

items.text: Sledders! It's time to let yourself be heard; dial into this new Season 26 update with some new gameplay features, adjustments and fixes.
Session visualization in the map view, showing your current play session,
Ride History, allowing you to view recorded replays and drone lines,
Replay Mode, Record and watch back your saved replays, rewind and fast forward and use Ghost Ride to drive alongside your own saved replays.
Mod.io integration, Allowing players to make and share customs wraps and maps.
Dedicated servers, for multiplayer sessions, improving stability and latency.
Voice Chat, allowing for players using the dedicated servers to talk to each other, both globally and locally (200m proximity-based).
Seeing is believing, so have a look at the update trailer!
We even reworked a lot of VFX and Audio, changing things like the fully reworked snowmobile snow and water visual effects and adding three new engine types for the SKS, Ace and the GGB quiet can.
📺VFX
Fully reworked snowmobile snow and water visual effects,
VFX are now synced with multiplayer drivers,
SKS Liberty 700
Ace 900 Turbo R
850 E-TEC GGB Quiet Can (available for all BRP sleds)
Added various new sound effects, including steering, driver, and drone sounds
Additional audio mixing and polishing,
Improved time and weather synchronization in multiplayer,
When using Fixed Time, forecast times now use system time,
Switching from Fixed to Dynamic time no longer changes the weather,
Adjusted some tree colliders and physics values,
Various other small fixes and improvements,
Other notes

Mod.io content: We are aware that not all mod content available to play testers did not completely carry over to this update. Mod.io will automatically show new mods added to the platform and become available over time.
We cannot approve mods that clearly infringe on an intellectual property of others.

mod.io has file upload limits, with a maximum file size of 8GB to 10GB per mod file, generally requiring files to be zipped. While the API documentation mentions certain endpoints for smaller files, the general platform limit accommodates large mods up to 10GB, designed to handle everything from small scripts to large total conversions.

Performance note: Using many custom wraps or very large custom levels can cause performance issues. If you’re experiencing slowdowns, crashes, or long loading times, we recommend reducing the number of active wraps and avoiding very large custom levels.
We're excited for you to jump in again and share your thoughts on this update!

Game Transitions: Move between different multiplayer and singleplayer games without returning to the garage or disconnecting.

releases.displayName: Slush Season is Here! 🌨️ 1st Major Update for Sledders Now Live! 🌨️

items.text: Yo, Sledheads!

We're thrilled to announce the first major update since the release of Sledders! This update is packed with features that will transform your sledding experience, taking it to new heights – literally and figuratively.

Trails are here! Yes, indeed. We brought trails to Sledders. This addition required us to develop an entirely new physics model tailored for trail riding. Riding on hard-packed snow trails is different compared to plowing through deep snow.
Roads! With road come… drumroll, please… DITCH BANGING! Prepare to take your sled airborne!
New sleds on the block! We're expanding your garage with several new sleds, including an innovative design featuring a single rail.

Customization options! Make your sled look like you want. Choose from a variety of C&A Pro skis, available in different colors, along with ROX Speed handguards and bar pads to make your sled truly yours.
All these features debut with our new map, High Peaks. Challenge yourself with its tough lines and steep climbs, designed to push your skills to the limit.

We're eager to hear your thoughts on this update. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve the Sledders experience. Let us know what you love, what you don't, and what you hope to see in the future.
Stay frosty and shred hard!
